_comment: Wide World Rendering PR 1, the far coast ring (docs/world-far, Tools/terrain/build_far_ring.py): per world, the band past the near terrain. inner_km: where the near chunks hand over (ALakeTerrainActor caps them there); outer_km: the band's outer edge from anywhere in the world's grid (45 km by default; a world bake's far_ring.draw_km, Marseille's 60, when the world has no entry here); tile_km: one Nanite mesh per tile; cell_m: the mesh spacing out to coarse_past_km from the grid, coarse_m beyond (cell_m and coarse_m divide the tile evenly, coarse twice cell).

_ultra._comment: build_far_ring.py --ultra (<World>.far30, drawn on Ultra): GLO-30 at 30.3 m out to coarse_past_km, 90.9 beyond (a fine tile's edge against a coarse one takes its line).
